Replay Foundry downloads these exact ONNX model bytes without modifying them.
Its English corrected-text alignment uses the separately installed ONNX Runtime
CPU provider and an independently implemented bounded CTC path decoder.
No audio or caption text is uploaded during model download or alignment.
